WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(w) AS avg_wins,
        AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
mean_average_wins AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT
    ta.team_id,
    ta.avg_wins,
    ta.avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss,
    ta.avg_wins - maw.mean_avg_wins AS gap_above_mean
FROM team_averages AS ta
CROSS JOIN mean_average_wins AS maw
WHERE ta.avg_wins > maw.mean_avg_wins
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
